name: reply-and-review-discipline
description: Replies to issue reporters and reviews of someone else's PR: plain words first, the reporter's own log lines, questions only when the report does not answer them, and one pending review the user publishes.

interface.shortDescription: Plain-first issue replies and pending reviews on others' PRs.
interface.longDescription: Fires when an agent replies to an issue reporter or outside contributor, or reviews someone else's pull request under the user's account. A reply leads with the diagnosis when the reporter's log shows the cause (their own log lines with arrow notes, then a numbered what-to-do list) and asks questions only when the diagnosis depends on the answers; the technical reading is collapsed and present only when it adds something; a reporter who writes in another language gets the full reply in that language first, then in English. A review of someone else's PR is staged as one pending review, verdict included as an inline summary comment, in a plain human voice, symptom then a one-line ask, only on what changes behavior, reliability, or the truth of a stated fact; publishing is the user's act.
defaultPrompt: Reply to this issue reporter in plain language first.
Stage a pending review of this PR under my account.
